edits.old: In a few short lines, Jesus tells us why
edits.new: In a few short lines, these verses tell us why
edits.why: Who is speaking in 3:16-18 is not settled: the teachers here hear Jesus, many Bibles hear John. The AI stated one reading as fact.

notes.text: Who is speaking here? Many Bibles end Jesus' words to Nicodemus at verse 15 and read verses 16-21 as John's reflection. Henry and Chrysostom, in this study, hear them as Jesus still speaking. Either way, it is God's word to us.
